lockedSettings.prompt: Output one landscape 2x2 cinematic storyboard sheet with exactly four widescreen frames separated only by narrow black gutters; include no title, labels, captions, numbers, or interface marks. Story continuity: the same covert operative in a tailored black suit and concealed earpiece crosses a luxury midnight gala inside one marble mansion under warm golden chandeliers. Preserve the same face, hair, suit, lighting, architecture, and tense elegant mood in all four frames. Frame one, upper left: low-angle wide entrance with the operative crossing the marble floor and guests in the foreground. Frame two, upper right: close over-shoulder view at the champagne bar with a security guard reflected in a mirror. Frame three, lower left: tight profile close-up of the earpiece and watchful eyes behind a foreground glass. Frame four, lower right: long symmetrical hallway exit with dramatic vanishing lines and the operative moving away. Each frame must be a genuinely different camera distance, angle, pose, and story beat while remaining a clean premium 16:9 movie still. Keep the four cells aligned, equally sized, sharp, and readable at thumbnail scale.
